content:
Demo target: a small Python HTTP API (workspace-seed) with a passing test suite and no auth yet.

Project: add authenticate_user so protected routes can tell who is calling.
Constraints seeded for tonight: Python 3.12, stdlib + the packages already in requirements.txt, no new cloud services unless a user marks them as must.
Existing layout: src/app.py (routes), src/users.py (in-memory user store), tests/test_app.py.
Success: unauthenticated requests to /me return 401; a successful login lets /me return the current user.
